title: Dealer Incentive and Rebate Settlement
summary: Calculate target-based dealer incentives, turnover rebates and cash discounts from your scheme terms and sales data, and check them against what dealers claim before finance pays.

seo.title: Dealer Incentive and Rebate Settlement | VipraTech
seo.description: Calculate and verify dealer incentives, turnover rebates and cash discounts from scheme terms and sales data, and reconcile them with dealer claims.

problem.intro: Durables, building materials, auto parts and agri-input brands pay dealers through target-based incentives, quarterly and annual turnover rebates, and cash discounts for early payment. Terms change every season, and finance calculates payouts in spreadsheets from sales and collection data, then argues with dealers who calculated differently.

pain_points.title: Complex scheme terms
pain_points.detail: Slabs, growth targets, product-mix conditions and qualifying periods make every payout a custom calculation.

pain_points.title: Sales and collections in different systems
pain_points.detail: Payouts depend on billing, returns and payment dates that sit in the ERP, the DMS and bank statements.

pain_points.title: Disputes with dealers
pain_points.detail: Dealers calculate their own entitlement, and without a line-by-line working, every difference becomes a dispute.

pain_points.title: Over-payment through returns and late payment
pain_points.detail: Sales later returned, or paid after the window, still count toward targets and discounts.

solution.overview: VipraTech turns each scheme's terms into rules: targets, slabs, eligible products, qualifying periods, exclusions and payment conditions. It calculates every dealer's entitlement from billing, returns and collection data, and compares it with what the dealer claims. Differences are explained line by line, such as a return that took a dealer below a slab or a payment that missed the cash-discount window. Finance reviews the differences and approves payouts, and each dealer gets a statement showing how their incentive was worked out.
capabilities: Scheme register with targets, slabs, product mix and qualifying periods
Calculates each dealer's entitlement from billing, returns and collections
Applies cash discount windows from actual payment dates
Compares calculated entitlement with dealer claims and explains differences
Dealer statements showing how each payout was worked out
Accrual report of incentives earned but not yet paid

workflow.title: Configure schemes
workflow.detail: Each scheme's targets, slabs, eligible products and conditions are entered as rules.

workflow.title: Load sales and collections
workflow.detail: Billing, returns and collection data for the period are taken from the ERP and bank records.

workflow.title: Calculate entitlements
workflow.detail: Each dealer's incentive, rebate and cash discount is calculated with a line-by-line working.

workflow.title: Compare with claims
workflow.detail: Calculated amounts are matched to dealer claims, and every difference gets a reason.

workflow.title: Finance review
workflow.detail: Finance reviews differences and approves payouts.

workflow.title: Pay and inform
workflow.detail: Credit notes or payouts are prepared, and each dealer gets a statement.

match_rules.logic: Only invoices dated within the scheme period count, for qualifying SKUs, net of returns and credit notes for that period.
The slab is set by net achievement against target. Growth schemes compare with the same period last year from your own billing.
Mix rules, such as a minimum share of a focus range, are checked before any slab is paid.
Where the scheme needs payment within a period, receipts are matched to invoices and late collections are left out.
Sales already rewarded under another scheme are left out where the circulars say schemes do not stack.

exception_codes.meaning: Net achievement is below the slab claimed.
The product-mix condition is not met.
exception_codes.action: Pay the base rate or nothing, as the circular says.

exception_codes.meaning: Some invoices were paid after the scheme's payment window.
exception_codes.action: Leave those invoices out of achievement.

exception_codes.meaning: The claim counts sales that were later returned.
The sales were already rewarded under another scheme.

inputs: Scheme circulars with targets, slabs and conditions
Billing and returns from the ERP
Payment dates from bank statements or the ERP
Dealer claims or statements of entitlement
outputs: Entitlement for every dealer, with its working
Differences from dealer claims, with reasons
Accrual of incentives earned but unpaid
human_in_the_loop: Finance approves every payout and decides on differences the rules cannot explain. Scheme interpretations are confirmed by the channel sales team before they are used.
integrations: ERP such as SAP, Tally or Oracle for billing, returns and credit notes
guardrails: Every payout has a line-by-line working
Returns and late payments applied before slabs are decided
Scheme rules versioned with a reference to the circular
Payouts released only after finance approval
compliance_notes: Volume rebates and discounts given after supply are usually settled by credit note for GST; the system keeps the link to the underlying invoices.

faqs.q: Our schemes have product-mix and growth conditions. Can those be rules?
faqs.a: Yes. Growth over a base period, product-mix thresholds, focus-product targets and exclusions are all configurable. Ambiguous terms are flagged for the channel team to clarify.

faqs.q: Do dealers need a new portal?
faqs.a: No. Statements can go by email or WhatsApp. A dealer portal can be added later if you want dealers to see their progress during the scheme.

faqs.q: Can dealers see their progress mid-scheme?
faqs.a: Yes. Entitlements can be recalculated daily or weekly, so dealers and sales teams see where they stand against each slab.

faqs.q: Is this the same system as your distributor claims settlement?
faqs.a: Yes. Every VipraTech workflow runs on one claims engine: the document reading, matching, review queue and audit trail are shared. For this workflow we set up your schemes as versioned rules, along with your document templates and matching keys.
